content.text:
I fixed the bug in `textutils/wrap.py`, and both tests in `tests/test_wrap.py` now pass. I didn't change the tests.

The width check was off by one. It used `<`, so it only added a word when the line came out shorter than `width`, and a line that exactly filled `width` was split. For example, `"aaa bbb"` at width 7 came out as two lines. I changed the check to `<=` so a line can be exactly `width` characters long, which is what the docstring says it should allow.
